name: Haiti
famous_for: Citadelle Laferrière fortress, Sans-Souci Palace, colorful naive folk painting, and the world's first Black republic.
tourists: Approx. 400,000 visitors; famous for Citadelle Laferrière, Bassin Bleu waterfall, and Jacmel artisan carnival.
must_know: Haiti made history in 1804 by becoming the first country in the world founded through a successful slave revolution.
fun_fact: Citadelle Laferrière, perched 900 meters atop Bonnet à l'Évêque mountain, is the largest fortress in the Americas.
